criteria.name: Explicit state ownership
criteria.evidence: Current kernel types separate parameters, immutable committed physical state, checkpoint, candidate, forcing, numerical configuration, result and worker-local model/workspace; F-MR41 and current runtime keep optional physical state typed.

criteria.name: Compact persistent state
criteria.evidence: F-KT12/F-KT13 carriers persist committed continuation plus provenance only; current WOFOST persistence excludes parameters, forcing and retired caches; F-MR41 allocates optional state only on admitted typed layouts.

criteria.name: Transactional correctness
criteria.evidence: kernel_advance_interval takes committed_state INTENT(IN), trials clone committed/checkpoint state, commit is the sole committed physical-state move, rollback only clears candidate; F-CI49P preserves definitive F-KT15 transaction composition.

criteria.name: Checkpoint / restore
criteria.evidence: Checkpoint is an immutable clone bound to lineage/revision/time and cannot publish. F-KT12 restore rejects initialized targets and mismatched schema/layout/provenance; F-MQ29 qualifies whole-registry atomic restore and rejected negative matrices.

criteria.name: Restart continuation
criteria.evidence: F-MQ27 qualifies real producer/consumer restart with continuous-versus-restarted endpoint identity; F-MQ29 extends exact midpoint/fresh reconstruction/endpoint identity through serialized and parallel continuation origins.

criteria.name: Generic time
criteria.evidence: Kernel/restart provenance stores generic real t0/t1 and committed time with exact origin validation; no file/calendar/day field exists in kernel persistence. WOFOST day-scale behavior is process-specific, not a kernel restart assumption.

criteria.name: Mass continuity
criteria.evidence: F-MQ27 qualifies exact interval mass continuation; F-MQ29 qualifies per-column residual <=1e-12 cm and aggregate mass/ledger identity. F-CI52P, F-CI55R and F-CI56 explicitly preserve hard mass policy.

criteria.name: Process-state completeness
criteria.evidence: Current serialized physical state includes hydraulic state, snow event/process continuation, restricted soil-temperature state, Richards temporal history when admitted, and fixed-weir state on its dedicated layout. Current WOFOST production source persists crop-owner continuation plus last-consumed event receipt.
